verdict.rationale: Salv documents that auto-closed alerts from clearance rules stay on the record as an audit trail. Cases can be worked with notes, documents, an assignee and a status, which implies a record of human handling. The evidence never shows timestamps, a unified log of human and automated case decisions, or a way for a compliance officer to retrieve or export that trail. Missing for 10: timestamped decision history, an explicit audit log of human case decisions, a retrieval/export mechanism (UI or API) for the audit trail, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can retrieve a timestamped audit trail of human and automated case decisions
